adaptation.verifier: finite vector; explicit clipping of roundoff down to-1e-6; positive norms; recomputed piecewise-linear convolution ratio
adaptation.scope: Arena observes exactly one original constructor call and binds its returned construction to the same pinned scorer and named verifier inputs. Original scorer bytes are retained in upstream_evaluator.py. Missing or ambiguous observations stay unknown. These checks establish finite representation feasibility and numerical consistency, not a theorem, exact algebraic certificate, optimum or paper reproduction.

limitations: Source-inspected SCiEL example; not a reproduced paper result.
The original evaluator and baseline are fetched at the immutable source commit; no upstream implementation is silently repaired.
